name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Matilda, 15 coins, and 17 coins go with Fletcher, Potter, and Tanner, in some order.
All of Edmund goes with 11 coins, Weaver does not go with Edmund, and Matilda goes with Tanner if and only if 15 coins goes with Tanner.
Either Potter goes with 13 coins or Potter goes with Rowan.
Either 11 coins goes with Beatrix or someone in the Clothiers' Guild goes with Beatrix (but not both).
Between Edmund and Fletcher, one goes with 11 coins and the other with 17 coins.

hints.text: Suppose Matilda went with Weaver — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Matilda goes with Weaver.
Matilda goes with Weaver, so it can't also go with Fletcher.
Matilda goes with Weaver, so it can't also go with Potter.
Matilda goes with Weaver, so it can't also go with Tanner.
…but now the clue “Matilda, 15 coins, and 17 coins go with Fletcher, Potter, and Tanner, in some order” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Matilda does not go with Weaver.
